title: Incompressible Navier-Stokes Limit of the Relativistic Boltzmann Equation with the Optimal Convergence Rate
summary: We study the diffusion limit of the classical solution to the relativistic Boltzmann equation with the initial data near a global relativistic Maxwellian. By using spectral analysis, we establish the convergence of the classical solution to the relativistic Boltzmann equation to that of the incompressible Navier-Stokes system, and give for the first time the optimal convergence rate and a precise estimate of the initial layer.
